info.name: FIT4110 Lab03 - 05_Consumer_side_Smoke
info.description: Consumer-side smoke tests to call dependent provider mocks

item.name: Consumer smoke - Camera/Core can call AI Vision mock

request.description: Consumer-side smoke test: call AI Vision mock

exec: pm.test('Consumer receives success from provider mock', function () { pm.expect(pm.response.code).to.eql(200); });

pm.test('Consumer can read detection fields', function () { const json = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(json).to.have.property('detection_id'); pm.expect(json).to.have.property('label'); pm.expect(json).to.have.property('confidence'); pm.expect(json.confidence).to.be.within(0, 1); });
